metadata.description: Renewable-geography sensitivity derived from market_data_IEEE_9Bus_distributed_congestion.json. The renewable fleet contains two PV nodes and one wind node: the original RES_PV_N6 profile is retained at N6, a 100 MW-peak PV profile is placed at N3, and a 200 MW-peak wind profile is placed at N8. The original N1 wind and N8 PV units are removed. Demand, conventional generation, PTDFs, line limits, and all other parameters are unchanged.
